name: mordred-flawless-blade-opponent-blade-makes-my-graveyard-attack-cards-float
notes: Mordred, Flawless Blade (WI2owxIw0z): "Attack cards in YOUR graveyard have floating memory." ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): HasFloatingMemory() (Custom/GameLogic.php) loops over BOTH players' fields and grants floating memory to every attack card in every graveyard as soon as ANY Flawless Blade is on the field, without checking that the Blade's controller is the graveyard's owner. Player 2's champion is Mordred, Flawless Blade; player 1 (plain Spirit of Water, no Flawless Blade) holds a Striking Tides in its graveyard. Player 1's real level-up into Mordred, Burnished Avenger (memory cost 1) is offered a floating payment with that Striking Tides -- answering with it banishes it for the cost and leaves the seeded memory card unspent. The REGRESSION GUARD assertions pin that outcome (rules-correct: no floating prompt, the memory card is banished).

rulesClauses: Attack cards in YOUR graveyard have floating memory (only the Blade's controller's graveyard).

engineBug.summary: An OPPONENT's Mordred, Flawless Blade makes the attack cards in MY graveyard float. HasFloatingMemory() (Custom/GameLogic.php) loops over BOTH players' fields and returns true for any attack card as soon as ANY Flawless Blade is on the field, without comparing the Blade's controller with the graveyard's owner. Confirmed live: with only player 2's champion being Flawless Blade, player 1's level-up into Burnished Avenger (memory cost 1) offers 'MZMULTICHOOSE:0|1|myGraveyard-0' for player 1's own Striking Tides, and answering banishes it.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php HasFloatingMemory() Mordred (WI2owxIw0z) branch iterating GetField(1) and GetField(2)
engineBug.verification: Root cause confirmed live with a temporary file trace (restored afterwards): HasFloatingMemory logged 'floating granted by a Flawless Blade on the field of player 2 to graveyard card qrxQGA1pc6 whose PlayerID=1'. Break/restore: restricting the Blade loop to the graveyard owner's field flipped this guard red (no floating prompt; the memory card is banished) while the own-Blade fixtures stayed green; restored, shasums verified.
